newsitem.title: USA: LCI International wins $19 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: LCI International wins $19 mln contract.

text.p: LCI International said on Tuesday it signed a multi-year contract valued at $19 million with Strategic Marketing & Communications, a New-York base provider of prepaid calling cards to national retailers.

Under terms of the agreement, LCI said its long-distance network would support Strategic Marketing's Classic Coinex prepaid calling cards. This would allow card users to place telephone calls from anywhere in the United States and to 230 countries worldwide, the company said.
LCI would also handle all customer support for the cards through its prepaid calling card customer service center.
Prepaid calling cards differ from traditional long-distance calling cards in that they are programmed with a preset amount of long-distance calling time.
